metaDescription: Meridian is a complete enchanting overhaul mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric. Five stat axes, 111 original enchantments, 25+ themed shelves, enchantment libraries, salvage tomes, and anvil upgrades.
ogDescription: A complete enchanting overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric. Five stat axes, 111 original enchantments, themed shelves, libraries, tomes, and more.

hero.lede: A complete enchanting overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).
hero.sub: Five independent stats replace vanilla's single power value. 111 original enchantments, 25+ themed shelf blocks, two-tier enchantment libraries, salvage and XP tomes, and anvil upgrades — all fully data-driven.

sections.title: Core Systems
sections.lede: Seven interlocking systems that transform Minecraft's enchanting from a single-click gamble into a deep progression mechanic. Full enchantment list →

items.title: Five-Stat Enchanting
html: Eterna, Quanta, Arcana, Rectification, and Clues — each axis controls a different aspect of enchanting power, variance, rarity bias, consistency, and preview visibility.

items.title: 111 Original Enchantments
html: Combat, ranged, tool, mobility, shield, elytra, and mount enchantments. All built on vanilla's data-driven EnchantmentEffectComponents with custom Java handlers.

items.title: Themed Shelves
html: 25+ shelf blocks spanning Overworld, Nether, Ocean, Deep Dark, and End tiers. Each contributes unique stat combinations. Fully data-driven via datapacks.

items.title: Enchantment Libraries
html: Two-tier pooling storage blocks that consolidate enchanted books into per-enchantment point banks. Basic (level 16 cap) and Ender (level 31 cap) variants.

items.title: Salvage Tomes
html: Three tomes for extracting enchantments: Scrap (random, destroys item), Improved Scrap (all, destroys item), and Extraction (all, preserves item).

items.title: XP Tomes
html: A ladder of consumables that bank experience levels. Right-click to deposit a level, shift-right-click to withdraw one. Three tiers crafted from a Dormant XP Tome hold 10, 30, and 50 levels. At the enchanting table they pay any cost your level bar can't cover automatically — no need to withdraw first.

items.title: Anvil Upgrades
html: Prismatic Web strips all curses from an item. Iron Blocks repair chipped and damaged anvils. Both configurable and toggleable.

sections.title: The Five Stats
sections.lede: Each stat is contributed by shelf blocks surrounding the enchanting table. Different shelf types push different stats, letting you tune your setup for the enchantments you want. Browse the shelves →

items.title: Eterna
html: Drives the maximum enchanting level. Each Eterna point grants two enchanting levels, so the 0–50 Eterna range yields enchanting levels up to 100 — far beyond vanilla's 0–30. Higher Eterna unlocks higher-tier enchantments and table crafting recipes. Each vanilla bookshelf provides +1 Eterna (capped at 15).

items.title: Quanta
html: Controls the upper bound of the random power roll. Higher Quanta means more variance — you might get amazing results or terrible ones. Tempered by Rectification.

items.title: Arcana
html: Biases the enchantment pool toward rarer, more obscure enchantments. High Arcana increases the chance of getting rare enchantments and is required for many table crafting recipes.

items.title: Rectification
html: Reduces the negative variance introduced by Quanta. High Rectification with high Quanta means consistently strong results without the downside of random garbage rolls.

items.title: Clues
html: Reveals additional enchantments in the tooltip preview before you commit. Each point of Clues shows one more enchantment from the result — invest enough and the preview reveals everything that slot will roll, reducing blind gambling.

sections.title: Enchanting Table Crafting
sections.lede: The enchanting table doubles as a stat-gated crafting station. When your shelf setup meets recipe thresholds, the third enchant slot becomes a crafting result.

items.title: Shelf Upgrades
html: Craft higher-tier shelves directly in the enchanting table. Hellshelves upgrade to Infused, Blazing, and Glowing variants. Seashelves upgrade to Infused, Crystal, and Heart variants. Dormant Deepshelves awaken into full Deepshelves.

items.title: Tome Progression
html: Scrap Tomes upgrade to Improved Scrap Tomes (Eterna 22.5+), which upgrade to Extraction Tomes (Eterna 30+). Each tier requires progressively higher stats.

items.title: Material Transmutation
html: Convert Dragon's Breath into Infused Breath (key material for End-tier shelves). Transmute Honey Bottles into Experience Bottles at three output tiers. Craft Budding Amethyst, Golden Carrots, Golden Apples, Enchanted Golden Apples, Hearts of the Sea, Totems of Undying, and duplicate Echo Shards.

items.title: Library Upgrade
html: Upgrade a Basic Library to a Library of Alexandria at the enchanting table. Requires maximum stats: Eterna 50, Quanta 45–50, Arcana 100. Preserves all stored enchantment data.

sections.title: Quick Install
sections.lede: Requires Fabric Loader 0.16.10+, Fabric API, and Java 21 on Minecraft 1.21.1.

items: Install Fabric Loader 0.16.10+ for Minecraft 1.21.1.
Launch the game. Config generates at config/meridian.json on first run.
Adjust settings via the config file or /meridian reload in-game.
blocks.note: Requires Java 21. Compatible with EMI, REI, JEI, Jade, WTHIT, and ModMenu.
